name: voice056 T 1.00 s vx 0.016 planned-y
command_line: A5_TIP_SCRIPTS=/tmp/tip-a5a9183/scripts MUJOCO_GL=glfw DISPLAY=:1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python3 scripts/score_a5a9183_signed_id.py --plan-y --out /tmp/a5-plan-y/plan_y.json

requires.note: The scorer sets WALK_GAIT_SCRIPTS to A5_TIP_SCRIPTS before importing score_walk_smoothness. That puts the tip's steer_walk, lipm_gait, op3_walk, and zmp_preview on sys.path. The default A5_TIP_SCRIPTS is /tmp/tip-a5a9183/scripts. The scorer sets MUJOCO_GL=glfw and DISPLAY=:1 when those are unset.

flags.feedforward_detail: The live command is a position target. Planned-ID torque is a scorer column on q_des. It is not added to data.ctrl.
flags.qdd_cap_detail: No knee q̈ cap. Planned q̈ is the backward difference of q_des at 8 ms. Realised qacc is (qvel_next - qvel) / dt.
flags.armature_source: plant XML joint attribute armature="0.01", loaded by MjModel.from_xml_path. MjSpec is not used. model.dof_armature is not written after compile.
flags.ctrl_source: Position servo. write_clipped stores q_des on knee, hip_pitch, and ank_pitch. Other joints are band-limited by e_sat first. The command is then clipped to ctrlrange ±2.09. On the gait_manager schedule the session slews hip, knee, and ankle pitch from the previous ctrl toward that target over gm_move_s 0.020 s, and not faster than 5.5 rad/s. The plant ask is |kp·(clip(data.ctrl, ±2.09)−q) − kv·q̇| at each 2 ms substep. During preview_stage stand the phase is stand, so each substep rewrites legs with write_force_limited at LEG_STOP_NM 2.28. The stop blend sets phase shift, so that stand rewrite stays off during the blend.

stop_blend.bus: CommandBus.stop calls stand and snaps applied vx and yaw rate to 0.
stop_blend.gait: preview path _tick_preview_stop. Finish the swing already in the air. Hold 0.20 s once both soles are under 3 mm and the clock is in double support, then plant. ZMP returns to 0 by a smootherstep over 1.50 s. Joints smootherstep from the frozen walk pose to q_stand over 2.0 s. Phase stays shift.
stop_blend.sole_pitch_null: During the 2 s blend, ankle pitch adds 4× measured sole pitch, capped at ±0.12 rad, faded over the last 20% of the blend. The swing ankle stays on the IK target.

duration.bus: vel(0.016, 0.0) resent while walking; one bus.stop at t_stop

recorded_outcome.tip_rule: A tip is a stop that unloads a foot (contacts under 3), rolls more than 5° off the stand, or drops up_z under 0.90. Pitch off the stand is the lean column.
